name: ci(v2): GHA workflow for top-reward SWE-Lancer subset

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      task_count:
        description: Number of top reward tasks to run (1-10)
        required: true
        default: '2'
        type: string
      agent:
        description: Agent to use
        required: true
        default: swe-agent
        type: string
      provider:
        description: Provider to use
        required: true
        default: openai
        type: string
      model:
        description: Model to use
        required: true
        default: gpt-4-turbo
        type: string
      timeout:
        description: Timeout in seconds
        required: true
        default: '1800'
        type: string

jobs:
  setup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      task_ids: ${{ steps.set-task-ids.outputs.task_ids }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set task IDs
        id: set-task-ids
        run: |
          TASK_COUNT=${{ github.event.inputs.task_count }}
          if [[ ! $TASK_COUNT =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || [ "$TASK_COUNT" -lt 1 ] || [ "$TASK_COUNT" -gt 10 ]; then
            echo "Invalid task_count: $TASK_COUNT"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          TASK_IDS=$(jq -r '.[:$COUNT] | join(",")' --arg COUNT "$TASK_COUNT" data/v2-top-reward-tasks.json)
          echo "task_ids=[\"$TASK_IDS\"]" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

  benchmark:
    needs: setup
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        task_id: ${{ fromJSON(needs.setup.outputs.task_ids) }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Task
        uses: arduino/setup-task@v2
        with:
          version: latest
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Run benchmark for task
        env:
          TASK_ID: ${{ matrix.task_id }}
          AGENT: ${{ github.event.inputs.agent }}
          PROVIDER: ${{ github.event.inputs.provider }}
          MODEL: ${{ github.event.inputs.model }}
          TIMEOUT: ${{ github.event.inputs.timeout }}
        run: |
          echo "Running benchmark for task $TASK_ID"
          # Add actual benchmark execution command here
          # Example: task run --task-id $TASK_ID --agent $AGENT --provider $PROVIDER --model $MODEL --timeout $TIMEOUT

      - name: Upload results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: benchmark-results-${{ matrix.task_id }}
          path: ./results/${{ matrix.task_id }}.json
